verdict.rationale: Restate documents versioning support for user services (immutable deployments, requests pinned to a single code version) via restate-docs-24/41, and SDK changelogs show incremental API evolution (restate-docs-44,73,74), but there is no documented deprecation policy for Restate's own APIs/SDKs that an AI-native consumer could rely on. missing for 10: an explicit deprecation policy or versioning guarantees for Restate's public APIs/SDKs, timeline for API sunset, and independent confirmation of long-term API stability.
